name: Workplace: corporate
about: A head office or a professional or financial services floor (law, consulting, banking): more cabins and enclosed rooms, a client suite at the front kept apart from the working floor, a boardroom, records. In three parts: the Workplace: corporate typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.2.0: its glazed walls in the versions that say they let light through (R160); nothing else changed.
